children.name: logo
children.label: Logo
children.help_text: Leave empty to use the theme logo (Theme settings > Branding > Site Logo).

children.name: logo_alt
children.label: Company name (logo alt text)
children.help_text: Used when the logo image has no alt text of its own, and shown as text when there is no logo at all.

children.name: navigation
children.label: Navigation menu
children.help_text: Top-level items show in the header. One level of child items shows as a dropdown; deeper levels are not shown.

children.name: show_mobile_cta
children.label: Show button in the mobile header bar
children.help_text: On: the button stays visible next to the menu toggle on phones. Off: on phones it appears at the bottom of the opened menu. The minimal header always shows it.
